description.zh: 按中转站分组管理模型价格：自定义中转站与模型名称，为每个模型填写输入/输出单价（元每百万 token），保存多组并一键切换当前生效价格。
description.en: Group model prices by provider: custom provider/model names, per-model input/output unit prices, save multiple groups and switch the active price with one tap.
description.default: Group model prices by provider; save multiple groups and switch active price with one tap.
